name: logismart
description: LogiSmart — SaaS multi-tenant pour entreprises de livraison (logistique, support IA, recrutement IA)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @logismart/shared && npm run build -w @logismart/api && npm run build -w @logismart/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @logismart/shared && npm run typecheck -w @logismart/api && npm run typecheck -w @logismart/web && npm run typecheck -w @logismart/local-client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @logismart/api && npm run lint -w @logismart/web && npm run lint -w @logismart/local-client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @logismart/api && npm run test -w @logismart/web
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start -w @logismart/api
